name: O QUEBRA-NOZES - IMPERIAL HERITAGE BALLET
description: The Imperial Heritage Ballet presents "O Quebra-Nozes" (The Nutcracker), a classic ballet with music by Tchaikovsky. This show takes the audience into Clara's magical night, where toys come to life and snowflakes dance.
longDescription:
The Imperial Heritage Ballet brings "O Quebra-Nozes" to Coliseu Porto Ageas. This ballet, set to Tchaikovsky's music, tells the story of Clara's magical night, filled with fantasy elements like living toys and enchanted kingdoms. The performance is suitable for audiences aged 6 and up.

The show is scheduled for November 28, 2026, at 15:00, in the Sala Principal of Coliseu Porto Ageas. Tickets range from €35 to €210, with various seating options available, including orchestra seats, plateia, tribuna, and camarotes.

For information on tickets for people with reduced mobility, contact the Coliseu Porto Ageas box office by phone at 223 394 940 or email at bilheteira@coliseu.pt.
